A01_pooled: Many of our taxa are rare and spread thinly across samples. Please let the denoising use the information from all samples together.
A02a_rarefaction_1000: For the diversity analyses, please rarefy to at least 1,000 reads per sample.
A02b_rarefaction_600: For the diversity analyses, please rarefy to at least 600 reads per sample, even if the shallowest samples have to be left out.
A03_no_qiime: We cannot use QIIME2 on our infrastructure.
A04_exclude_archaea: We are only interested in bacteria. Please also remove archaeal ASVs, in addition to mitochondria and chloroplasts.
A05_min_frequency_5: Please keep rarer ASVs: only remove those with fewer than five reads in total.
A06_truncation: Please truncate forward reads at 230 bases and reverse reads at 180 bases.
A07_no_diff_abundance: I am in a hurry and do not need any differential abundance testing.
A08_no_decontam: We did not sequence any negative controls in this run.
A09a_skip_quality: We have already checked read quality ourselves, so please skip the DADA2 quality profiling.
A10_kraken2: Please assign taxonomy with Kraken2 and the Greengenes database instead of DADA2.
A11_picrust: We would also like an estimate of the metabolic functions that our communities may carry.
A12_silva: Our group reports taxonomy against SILVA 138 rather than GTDB. Please classify the sequences with that reference.
